hero.title: Engineered for Substance, Not Software Bloat
hero.subtitle: VibePress Studio was created to build software tools that respect system resources and user privacy. We specialize in high-performance digital tools and modular WordPress infrastructure.

vision.headline: Engineered for Substance, Not Software Bloat
vision.narrative: VibePress Studio was created to build software tools that respect system resources and user privacy. We specialize in modular, high-performance WordPress infrastructure and enterprise-grade web tools.
vision.philosophy: We avoid bloated architectures, unnecessary database tables, and unneeded cloud dependencies. Operating on enterprise WordPress sites, our tools deliver deterministic, rock-solid performance.

pillars.title: Modular, Standards-Based WordPress Code
pillars.desc: Engineered strictly according to WordPress Core Coding Standards (WPCS), PSR-4 class auto-loading, and PSR-12 conventions.

pillars.title: High-Performance Routing & Database Efficiency
pillars.desc: Leveraging clean query engines, transient caching, and optimized database queries to deliver sub-millisecond execution speeds.

pillars.title: 100% Data Sovereignty & Privacy
pillars.desc: Your data stays on your server. We implement GDPR IP anonymization, bot filtering, and local data storage with zero external tracking pixels.

pillars.title: Enterprise Security & Legal Compliance
pillars.desc: Built-in compliance engines for FTC legal auto-disclosure, Smart ToS uncloaking, and secure licensing validation.
